policy: Whole TRAIN sources read before judgments. Unchanged entity spans; explicit source operator attribution rather than entity-type filling. Inverse receiver/operator negatives are record-local, not universal claims that a family can never solve a task. Untested internal components and unresolved co-reference remain UNRESOLVED. Repeated named mentions are correlated, not independent measurements.
